Laboratory staf members participate in project planning, safety evaluations, startup reviews, and operations activities to ensure permit and regulatory compliance and address air quality considerations. 5.1 Criteria Pollutants and Hazardous Air Pollutants The primary sources of regulated pollutants at NREL are fuel use, chemical use, and facility operations. Specifc sources include process heat boilers, process cooling systems, comfort heating and cooling systems, emergency generators, construction and maintenance equipment with gasoline or diesel engines, bench- and pilot-scale research activities, use of chemicals, facility operation, and maintenance activities.
